sparql_query:
# IMDb-backed local filters applied after WDQS
# title_types: ['movie']
# runtime_min_minutes: 60
# year_from: 2010
# year_to: 2025
# rating_imdb_max: 4.5
SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?imdb ?itemLabelEn ?itemLabelRu WHERE {
      ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q11424 .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q506240 . }
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q24862 . }
      FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q202866 . }
      ?item wdt:P345 ?imdb .
      ?item wdt:P136 wd:Q2484376 .
      BIND(wd:Q23572 AS ?seed) .
      ?seed wdt:P161 ?bridgeActor .
      ?item wdt:P161 ?bridgeActor .
      FILTER(?item != ?seed) .
      ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabelEn FILTER(LANG(?itemLabelEn) = "en") .
      OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?itemLabelRu FILTER(LANG(?itemLabelRu) = "ru") . }
    }
    LIMIT 900

# Actor-answer task. IMDb-backed local filters are applied to evidence titles after WDQS

SELECT DISTINCT ?actor ?title ?imdb ?actorLabelEn ?actorLabelRu ?titleLabelEn WHERE {
